sections.chapter_title: Connectivity line devices: reset and clock control (RCC)
sections.text_helper: Section 8.3.11 "AHB peripheral clock reset register (RCC_AHBRSTR)" in chapter 8 (Connectivity line devices: reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 153.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Access: no wait state, word, half-word and byte access
Reserved
Bits 31:15 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 14 ETHMACRST Ethernet MAC reset
Set and cleared by software.
0: No effect
1: Reset ETHERNET MAC
Bit 13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 OTGFSRST USB OTG FS reset
Set and cleared by software.
0: No effect
1: Reset USB OTG FS
Bits 11:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
